original_test_intent: Validate FH11 through FH15 transceiver thermal records across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web Sensor List views against the approved FH/TRX specification.
original_method: The FH/link owner defines the 11–15 segment, maps each exact channel to a transceiver type, port/lane and stable module/device identity, defines the thermal sensing origin and link-state envelope, and automation reconciles complete read-only management views.
manual_activity: The FH/link owner defines the five-device segment, port/module identities and sensor origins, approves link-state-qualified limits, confirms generic Web Sensor List mappings, and keeps the following Dashboard/Server Health UI checkpoint separate.
required_inputs: Authoritative FH and TRX definitions plus reason for the 11–15 segment
Exact TEMP_FH11_TRX through TEMP_FH15_TRX names and fitted population
Per-index board location, port/lane, peer and module serial/PN or stable device identity
Sensing source: module DOM, SerDes/ASIC die, remote diode or board probe
Units, scale, tolerance, refresh, stale/unavailable and module-not-present semantics
Ranges/thresholds by transceiver type, link speed/state, traffic, airflow and ambient condition
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List and generic Web mapping with same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent link/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve five exact names; do not query the combined range as proof
Do not infer FH1-FH10 coverage or equate FH index with dynamic port enumeration
Bind each reading to stable module/device, port/lane and sensor origin
Do not use the following UI-only case as a substitute for complete IB/OOB command coverage
Do not service modules, reset links, reload drivers, create traffic, alter cooling/thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on mapping/population change, link fault, stale/invalid telemetry, view disagreement or thermal event
agent_execution_scope: Verify source identity, five-name expansion, segment boundary and separate UI-row scope
Verify transceiver/port/lane/module topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, five exact results and generic BMC Web Sensor List
Compare identity/value/state/freshness with passive link speed/state/error/traffic/airflow/SEL context
Perform no UI-row substitution, module service, link/driver/workload action, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define FH/TRX and approve FH11-FH15 port/module/device map
Explain segment boundary and define sensor origin distinct from FH Chip
Provide transceiver/link-state-specific limits and not-present rules
Review all views for five channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED
